scope: degree10 mechanism and engineering pilot; not a reproduction of paper tables or a continuous WDRO certificate
selection: earliest minimum validation OOD worst-group cost; all checkpoints eligible including initialization; report nominal separately
rho: q75 of all 32 perturbation costs on a separate 256-center training-only calibration; separately for rooted and unrooted costs
attack: heldout Random/Sobol 32 + center, all 33 scored, finite-support LP under shared average rho; no ES, learned critic attack, RL attack or CEM

statistics.unit: paired training seeds and matched heldout nets; no universal superiority claims

baseline: same new permutation invariant action-independent MLP within each ERM/WDRO pair; original REST actor uses trusted DAC21 initialization; paper actors initialize from scratch
